domain-information: As a city resident, I want to find the nearest bike station, so that I can start my bike ride quickly.
As a city resident, I want to rent a bike for a short ride, so that I can travel across town conveniently.
As a city resident, I want to see available bikes at my home and work stations, so that I can plan my route.
As a maintenance worker, I want to check bike conditions regularly, so that all bikes are safe to ride.
As a city planner, I want to see bike usage patterns, so that I can improve station placement.
As a city planner, I want to make a suggestion for station placement, so they align with the demand.
As a city resident, I want to return the bike to any station, so that I have flexibility in my route.
As a docking station manager, I want to track available docks, so that I can redistribute bikes when needed.
As a city resident, I want to reserve a bike at a station, so that I am guaranteed transportation during peak hours.
As a maintenance worker, I want to log repairs, so that the system knows which bikes are out of service.
As a city resident, I want to report a damaged bike, so that it can be fixed promptly.
As a city resident, I want to track my ride history, so that I can manage my transportation budget.
As a system administrator, I want to analyze bike usage, so that I can redistribute them to high-demand areas.
As a city resident, I want to know the pricing for trips, so that I can decide when to ride.
As a maintenance worker, I want to schedule regular bike inspections, so that the fleet remains operational.
As a city resident, I want to report stolen bikes, so that the system administrator can take action.
As a system administrator, I want to manage stations, so that bike coverage is optimal.
As a system Administrator, I want to issue a bike delivery, so that bikes are distributed from one station to another.
As a bike delivery worker, I want to deliver bikes to another station, so that the station has supplies.
As a system administrator, I want to review suggestions for station placements, so that I can approve or deny them.
As a city resident, I want to participate in community events promoting biking, so that I contribute to sustainable transportation.
As a community event manager, I want to plan a community event, so that city residents can participate.
As a community event manager, I want to assign a station and a date for a community event.

domain objects.name: City Resident
domain objects.description: Person using bikes and stations for city transport.

domain objects.name: Bike Station
domain objects.description: Place where bikes are docked, rented, or returned.

domain objects.name: Availability Status
domain objects.description: Shows if bikes or docks are available at a station.

domain objects.name: Location
domain objects.description: Represents a specific area or address of a station or event.

domain objects.name: Bike Ride
domain objects.description: Represents a single trip taken by a user.

domain objects.name: Bike
domain objects.description: Physical bicycle that can be rented for rides.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Worker
domain objects.description: Checks and repairs bikes to keep them in good shape.

domain objects.name: Bike Usage Data
domain objects.description: Aggregated information about bike rides and usage patterns.

domain objects.name: City Planner
domain objects.description: Analyzes data to improve bike network placement and policies.

domain objects.name: Docking Station Manager
domain objects.description: Oversees station operations and ensures bike availability.

domain objects.name: Dock
domain objects.description: Single locking spot at a station for one bike.

domain objects.name: Reservation
domain objects.description: Holds a bike temporarily for a rider before a trip.

domain objects.name: Payment
domain objects.description: Transaction made for rides or subscriptions.

domain objects.name: Repair Log
domain objects.description: Record of repairs made to a bike.

domain objects.name: Damage Report
domain objects.description: Report from a user about a broken or malfunctioning bike.

domain objects.name: Ride History
domain objects.description: List of past rides taken by a city resident.

domain objects.name: System Administrator
domain objects.description: Manages overall operations and technical aspects of the bike system.

domain objects.name: Bike Inspection
domain objects.description: Regular check to ensure a bike meets safety and maintenance standards.

domain objects.name: Theft Report
domain objects.description: Notice filed when a bike goes missing or is stolen.

domain objects.name: Community Event
domain objects.description: Public activity promoting bike use and sustainability.

domain objects.name: Community Event Manager
domain objects.description: Organizes and oversees community biking events.

domain objects.name: Bike Delivery
domain objects.description: Process of moving bikes between stations to balance availability.

domain objects.name: Bike Delivery Worker
domain objects.description: Performs bike redistribution tasks between stations.

associations.description: City Resident starts and completes a Bike Ride.
City Resident makes a Reservation to secure a Bike Ride.
City Resident provides Payment for rides or membership.
Reservation ensures a Bike Ride is available to the user.
Bike Ride uses a specific Bike for travel.
Each Bike Ride contributes to the collected Bike Usage Data.
Bike Ride is recorded in a user’s Ride History.
City Resident has a Ride History of past trips.
Bike is stored or returned at a Bike Station.
Bike is placed in a specific Dock when not in use.
Bike Inspection checks the condition of a Bike.
Bike Delivery moves Bikes between stations.
Bike Station contains multiple Docks for Bikes.
Docking Station Manager oversees the status of each Dock.
Docking Station Manager monitors Availability Status at stations.
Maintenance Worker performs regular Bike Inspections.
Maintenance Worker creates entries in the Repair Log.
Repair Log details issues and fixes related to a specific Bike.
City Resident submits a Damage Report for a broken Bike.
Damage Report is assigned to a Maintenance Worker for fixing.
City Resident files a Theft Report for a missing Bike.
System Administrator handles Theft Reports and investigations.
System Administrator reviews and maintains the Bike Usage Data.
System Administrator coordinates Bike Delivery tasks.
Bike Delivery moves Bikes between Bike Stations.
Bike Delivery Worker executes the Bike Delivery process.
City Planner analyzes Bike Usage Data for planning improvements.
City Planner proposes new stations based on data insights.
Community Event Manager organizes Community Events at stations.
